# Japan by Station

> Carefully checked English guides to Japan travel, quick answer first: where to stay, what is within walking distance, local markets, nightlife, and how many minutes it takes to reach the airport, day trips and sights. Every time and price is checked against operators, airports and tourism bureaus, with the check date shown on each page.

## Station guides (start here)
- [Food Near Hakata Station: Seven Places From a 7am Beef-Tongue Breakfast to Midnight Ramen](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-hakata-station): Hungry at Hakata Station? Beef-tongue breakfast from 7:00, sea bream rice, ramen to midnight and mizutaki for one. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Breakfast: Hakata Station feeds you from 7:00: Tanya HAKATA (beef tongue) in Hakata 1bangai B1, 7:00–23:00; Kisuimaru seafood breakfast 7:30–10:00. Late: Shin-Shin in DEITOS serves ramen until 24:00 (last order 23:30); Hakata Issou, 6 min east, 11:00–24:00, cash only. Dinner: Hamadaya Kuten cooks mizutaki for one on JR Hakata City 10F, 11:00–22:00. All picks 4★+ on Google Maps when checked, 26 Nov 2026.
- [Food Near Kyoto Station: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner, Side by Side](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-kyoto-station): Hungry at Kyoto Station? Breakfast inside the gates from 6:30, ramen until 1:00 and a tofu dinner, by exit. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Breakfast: Shiokoji Cafe, inside the JR Central gate by Platform 0, opens 6:30 every day; Honke Daiichi Asahi ramen from 6:00 (closed Thursdays). Lunch: Shinpuku Saikan chuka soba ¥950 (9:00–20:00, cash only); Mimikou curry udon by the Karasuma East gate. Dinner: Kyo-tofu Fujino and Kyoto Obuya in Isetan 11F, 11:00–22:00. Facts checked 26 November 2026.
- [Food Near Namba Station: Eight Places From a Morning Cheesecake to Late-Night Skewers](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-namba-station): Hungry at Namba? Cheesecake from 9:30, omurice under Takashimaya, kitsune udon and Ura-Namba skewers to 23:30. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Morning: Namba starts late: Rikuro's cheesecake shop opens 9:30 daily, takoyaki Wanaka 10:30 (9:30 Saturdays and holidays). Lunch: Hokkyokusei omurice in Takashimaya B1 (10:00–20:00), 551 Horai pork buns (closed 1st and 3rd Tuesdays), Imai kitsune udon ¥930 (closed Wednesdays). Late: Osaka Yakiton Center in Ura-Namba, 15:00–23:30, PayPay only. Facts checked 26 November 2026.
- [Food Near Osaka Station (Umeda): Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and a Late Supermarket](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-osaka-umeda-station): Hungry at Osaka Station? Seven Umeda picks by meal, from 7:00 coffee to curry at 23:00, plus the supermarket by the gates. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Breakfast: Umeda Coffee-kan YC in Shin-Umeda Shokudogai, 2 min from JR Osaka, opens 07:00 every day (cash only). Lunch: Hanshin's ikayaki, B1 Snack Park, 10:00–22:00, under ¥200; Ekimae Building basements for udon and set lunches. Evening: Kyu Yamu Tetsudo spice curry in LUCUA B2 until 23:00; BIO-RAL supermarket by the Eki Marché gate 09:00–22:00. Facts checked 26 November 2026.
- [Food Near Sapporo Station: 7 Places From a 6:30 Hokkaido Breakfast to Zangi at 23:00](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-sapporo-station): Hungry at Sapporo Station? Kaiten sushi on 6F, soup curry off Chi-Ka-Ho, miso ramen and zangi until 23:30. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): In the station: Nemuro Hanamaru kaiten sushi and Dekitateya seafood bowls are both on Sapporo Stellar Place 6F; Hanamaru 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) with numbered tickets at the door. Soup curry without going outside: Suage4 on miredo 2F connects to the Chi-Ka-Ho underground walkway, 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30). Late: Sapporo Zangi Honpo by the North exit serves until 23:30 (last order 23:00), cash only. All picks 4★+ on Google Maps when checked, 26 Nov 2026.
- [Food Near Shibuya Station: 8 Places by Exit, From 8am Coffee to Noodles at 6am](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-shibuya-station): Hungry at Shibuya Station? Sushi in Mark City, set meals in Hikarie, a 1932 yakitori counter and noodles until 7am. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Inside the station buildings: d47 Shokudo on Shibuya Hikarie 8F (regional set meals, 11:30–16:00 and 18:00–21:00) and Sushi no Midori in Mark City East 4F (to 21:00, last order 20:30). Late: Chatei Hatou serves coffee until 23:00; Bura Bura on Dogenzaka serves abura soba 11:00–7:00 next morning. Cash only: Kiraku, Torifuku and Chatei Hatou. All eight picks 4★+ on Google Maps when checked, 26 Nov 2026.
- [Food Near Shinjuku Station: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Late Night by Exit](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-shinjuku-station): Hungry at Shinjuku Station? Seven picks by exit and meal, from 6:20 soba to 24-hour ramen, with hours and prices. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Breakfast: Kameya soba, 2 min from the West Exit, opens 06:20 (Mon–Sat, cash only); Sawamura in NEWoMan serves breakfast 07:00–10:00. Lunch: Fuunji tsukemen ¥1,000 (11:00–15:00, 17:00–21:00, 6 min from the South Exit); Manna's Indian-style curry, served since 1927, ¥2,200. Late: Nagi in Golden Gai is open 24 hours; Keika ramen by the East Exit until 23:00. Facts checked 26 November 2026.
- [Food at Tokyo Station: Seven Places From a 5:30 Bento to Monja at 22:00, Inside and Outside the Gates](https://japanbystation.com/food-near-tokyo-station): Hungry at Tokyo Station? Ekiben from 5:30 inside the gates, tsukemen from 7:30, vegan ramen, standing sushi and monja until 23:00. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Earliest: Ekibenya Matsuri inside the gates sells 150+ kinds of ekiben from 5:30 to 22:00 every day; Rokurinsha on Tokyo Ramen Street serves a morning menu 7:30–9:45. Inside vs outside: Matsuri is inside the JR gates; Tokyo Ramen Street, the Ichibangai restaurants and Kurobei Yokocho are just outside the Yaesu gates, open to about 23:00. Vegan: T's Tantan (B1, outside the gates, 10:00–22:00) uses no meat, fish, eggs or dairy. Facts checked 26 November 2026.
- [Coin Lockers at Kyoto Station: Prices, Where the Big Ones Are, What to Do When They're Full](https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-station-coin-lockers): Big case at Kyoto Station? Where the large lockers are, what they cost, and how to send the case to your hotel when they're full. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Prices: about ¥400 small, ¥500 medium, ¥700 large, ¥1,000 oversized per day; JR Central's Hachijo smart lockers ¥400/500/700, cashless, bookable a month ahead for ¥500. Biggest cluster: the Hachijo (Shinkansen) side; Kintetsu has only 45 coin lockers, ¥100 coins only. Plan B: same-day hotel delivery in Kyoto if you drop the case by 14:00 (Crosta Kyoto, pikuraku lockers); checked 26 Nov 2026.
- [Kyoto Station to Arashiyama: 11 Minutes by JR, or the Slower Way That Drops You at Tenryu-ji](https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-station-to-arashiyama): Kyoto Station to Arashiyama: JR in 11 minutes for ¥240, or the tram that stops by Tenryu-ji. Which station, which order. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Fastest: JR Sagano Line, Kyoto Station platform 32 to Saga-Arashiyama, 11 minutes by rapid train, ¥240 (route search for Wed 16 Dec 2026). Bus: city bus 28 from stop C6 to Arashiyama Tenryuji-mae, about 47 minutes, ¥230; Kyoto's tourism site calls the bus from Kyoto Station crowded and slow. Calmer: subway Karasuma + Tozai lines to Uzumasa Tenjingawa, then the Randen tram to Arashiyama: about 45 minutes, ¥510, two changes. Checked 26 Nov 2026.
- [Coin Lockers at Namba Station: Where the Extra-Large Ones Are, Prices, and Plan B for Airport Cases](https://japanbystation.com/namba-station-coin-lockers): Big airport case at Namba? Where the extra-large lockers are, what they cost, and the counter that sends your case to the airport. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Extra-large lockers are rare: Nankai Namba lists 8 (6 at the north exit by Sumitomo Mitsui, 2 at the Central gate by the Japan Post ATM); Kintetsu/Hanshin Osaka-Namba lists 8 at the East gate (¥800–1,000). Prices: about ¥400 small to ¥700 large at Nankai and ¥400–900 at Kintetsu; many Nankai and Osaka Metro lockers want cash, so carry ¥100 coins. Plan B: n·e·s·t on Nankai Namba 2F (9:00–21:00) stores cases up to 220 cm for ¥800 a day, up to 14 days, or sends them to Kansai Airport for ¥2,500. Checked 26 Nov 2026.
- [Coin Lockers at Osaka Station: Prices, the Quieter Side, and What to Do When They're Full](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-station-coin-lockers): Big case at Osaka Station? Where the large lockers are, which side is quieter, and where the case goes when they're full. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Prices: JR Osaka Station lockers about ¥400 small, ¥500 medium, ¥700 large per day; cash or any Japanese IC card (Suica, PASMO, ICOCA and others). Biggest banks: the Central locker room (about 160 large) and the Sakurabashi side (about 126 large across four banks), per the Osaka tourism bureau's count. Plan B: JR West's ICOCA Locker Search shows free lockers live; Crosta Osaka stores bags for ¥1,000 or delivers to Osaka city hotels for ¥2,000 (9:00–20:00). Checked 26 Nov 2026.
- [Shin-Osaka Station: Where to Eat and Where to Leave Your Bags](https://japanbystation.com/shin-osaka-station-food-and-lockers): Changing trains at Shin-Osaka? Where the big lockers are, staffed storage and hotel delivery, and three places to eat by the gates. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Lockers: Osaka's official tourism site lists 9 locker banks at Shin-Osaka with about 200 large lockers but only 4 extra-large, all by the JR East exit (south side); about ¥400–1,000 a day. Staffed: Crosta Shin-Osaka, 9:00–20:00, ¥1,000 per bag a day or ¥2,000 to deliver it to your hotel the same day. Eat: Kissa Sancho opens 7:20 (1F, PayPay, no cards); Restaurant Yokoo's beef-katsu sandwich inside the Shinkansen gates; Uoya Stand Fuji to 23:00. Checked 26 Nov 2026.
- [Coin Lockers at Shinjuku Station: Prices, Where the Big Ones Are, What If They're Full](https://japanbystation.com/shinjuku-station-coin-lockers): Big case at Shinjuku? 42 large lockers by the Narita Express platforms, prices by size, and plan B when they're full. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Prices at JR Shinjuku: SS ¥300, S ¥500, M ¥700–800, L ¥900–1,000 per use; M and L can cost ¥100–200 more in busy seasons (JR East, checked 26 Nov 2026). Quietest big bank: inside the gates on the B1 passage to Platforms 5–6 (Narita Express): 42 large lockers, which JR East calls a less crowded spot. Book ahead: Multi ecube lockers can be reserved up to a month ahead for ¥500; same-day hotel delivery if you book by 9:30 and drop off by 11:00.
- [Luggage at Tokyo Station: Coin Lockers, Staffed Storage for Several Days, and the Quiet Lockers](https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-station-coin-lockers): Big case at Tokyo Station? Locker prices, why the large ones go first, multi-day storage at ¥420 a night, and the quiet lockers underground. Key facts (checked 2026-11-26): Prices: JR East lockers at Tokyo Station cost about ¥300 (SS), ¥500 (S), ¥700–800 (M) and ¥900–1,000 (L) a day; checked 26 Nov 2026. Big lockers are scarce: the largest bank, inside the gates on B1 by GRANSTA, has 728 small, 152 medium and only 40 large lockers. Several nights: the staffed Baggage Storage Center keeps bags for ¥420 per piece per night (¥840 from night six), 8:00–20:00.
- [Hakata Station: Which Exit? Hakata vs Chikushi, Airport Subway, Ramen](https://japanbystation.com/hakata-station-which-exit): Hakata side or Chikushi side? Which exit for the bus terminal, Canal City and the airport subway, plus lockers, ramen and a saveable exit card. Key facts (checked 2026-11-25): Hakata exit (west): faces Tenjin; Hakata Bus Terminal about 1 min (city buses 1F, highway buses 3F), Canal City about 10 min on foot, KITTE and Hakata Hankyu. Chikushi exit (east): the airport-direction side; Yodobashi Hakata right outside, JR Kyushu Hotel Blossom Fukuoka about 2 min. Subway Airport Line: Hakata to Fukuoka Airport 2 stops, about 5 min, ¥260; to Tenjin about 5 min. Lockers: JR Kyushu lockers ¥400–1,200 by size; Multi E-Cube lockers with same-day hotel delivery. Checked 25 November 2026.
- [Kyoto Station Food Halls: The Classic Gift vs What Kyoto Buys](https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-station-depachika-gifts): Yatsuhashi or Saturday-only ohagi? Kyoto's three food halls, pair by pair, with the sweets that only arrive on set days. Key facts (checked 2026-11-25): JR Kyoto Isetan (inside Kyoto Station): 10:00–20:00; B1 sweets, sake and long-established shops, B2 fresh food, deli and bento; Eat Paradise 11F 11:00–22:00. Set-day sweets at Isetan B1 (Nov 2026): Imanishiken ohagi Saturdays from 11:00, 3 for ¥721; Nakamuraken mugite-mochi Thursdays and Sundays, 3 for ¥1,053. Takashimaya Kyoto 10:30–20:00, food on B1; Tsuruya Yoshinobu's Kyoto-only yokan 3 bars ¥1,274, keeps about a year.
- [Kyoto Station: Which Exit? Karasuma vs Hachijo, Buses, Lockers, Food](https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-station-which-exit): Karasuma side or Hachijo side? Which exit for buses, Kintetsu and the airport bus, plus lockers, ramen and a saveable exit card. Key facts (checked 2026-11-25): Karasuma (Central) exit, north: city bus terminal, Kyoto Tower, taxis, the Karasuma subway. Hachijo exit, south: Shinkansen side, Kintetsu to Nara, airport limousine buses (KIX ¥2,800, about 85–90 min). City bus: ¥230 flat fare; EX100/EX101 sightseeing express ¥500 from stop D1, weekends and holidays. Luggage: JR Central smart lockers on the Hachijo side from ¥400 a day; same-day hotel delivery if dropped by 11:00. Checked 25 November 2026.
- [Sapporo Station: Which Exit? South vs North, Chi-Ka-Ho to Odori, Airport Train](https://japanbystation.com/sapporo-station-which-exit): South or North exit? Which way for Odori, the airport train and the buses, plus lockers, food and a saveable exit card. Key facts (checked 2026-11-25): South exit: Daimaru, Stellar Place, the Chi-Ka-Ho underground walkway to Odori (about 520 m, about 10 min, open 5:45–24:30), the Clock Tower about 10 min on foot. North exit: Hokkaido University (West gates, about 7 min to the Main Gate) and the tour-bus stop. Rapid Airport to New Chitose: ¥1,230, fastest about 33–37 min; u-seat reserved car +¥1,000 (+¥800 ticketless). Buses: the station bus terminal closed on 30 Sep 2023; buses use temporary street stops around the South exit. Checked 25 November 2026.
- [Shin-Osaka vs Osaka Station: Which One, and Where to Stay](https://japanbystation.com/shin-osaka-vs-osaka-station): Bullet train or city base? Which station your train uses, the 11-minute transfer rule, and one hotel per traveller. Key facts (checked 2026-11-25): Two different stations: the Tokaido and Sanyo Shinkansen stop only at Shin-Osaka (platforms 20–27); Osaka Station (Umeda) has no Shinkansen platforms. They are one JR stop apart, about 4 minutes. Kyoto from either one: the JR Special Rapid starts at Osaka Station, calls at Shin-Osaka and reaches Kyoto in about 24 minutes from Shin-Osaka; the regular fare is ¥580 from both (JR West, checked 25 Nov 2026). Transfer time: JR West advises allowing 11 minutes to change from JR to the Osaka Metro Midosuji Line at Shin-Osaka (Umeda about 6 min, Namba about 16 min). Stay by traveller: early Shinkansen → remm Shin-Osaka (directly connected to the Shinkansen Central gate); families → Courtyard by Marriott Shin-Osaka Station (1 min, rooms from 30 m²); budget with a bath → Via Inn Shin-Osaka (3 min from the JR East Exit).
- [Namba Station: Which Namba, Which Exit for Your Hotel](https://japanbystation.com/namba-station-which-namba): Four stations called Namba: which one your train uses, which exit to take and where to sleep. Key facts (checked 2026-11-24): Four stations called Namba: Osaka Metro Namba (Midosuji M20, Yotsubashi Y15, Sennichimae S16), Nankai Namba (trains to Kansai Airport and Koyasan), Osaka-Namba (Kintetsu to Nara and Hanshin to Kobe, one shared station) and JR Namba (Yamatoji Line). All are linked on foot, mostly underground. To Kansai Airport: Nankai rapi:t from Nankai Namba, 34 min at the fastest; Airport Express about 45 min for the ¥970 base fare. Limousine bus from OCAT (JR Namba building) about 48 min to Terminal 1, ¥1,400 adult (checked 24 Nov 2026). Destination-first exits: Dotonbori → Osaka Metro Exit 14; Namba Parks and Nankai trains → Exit 4; Namba HIPS → Exit 15-B walkway; Kintetsu/Hanshin and Namba Walk → Exit 27 direction. Stay by traveller: airport by train → Swissotel Nankai Osaka (on top of Nankai Namba); airport bus, Nara or Kobe → Hotel Monterey Grasmere Osaka (1 min from JR Namba); nights out → Cross Hotel Osaka (3 min from Exit 14); rainy days and laundry → Namba Oriental Hotel (30 s from Namba Walk B21).
- [Osaka Station vs Umeda: Same Place? Which Side for Your Hotel](https://japanbystation.com/osaka-station-vs-umeda): Six stations, one hub: which one your train uses, where the airport bus stops, and the right side for your hotel. Key facts (checked 2026-11-24): Same hub, different stations: JR uses the name Osaka Station; Hankyu and Hanshin use Osaka-umeda (renamed from Umeda on 1 October 2019); Osaka Metro has Umeda, Higashi-Umeda and Nishi-Umeda. All are linked on foot. HARUKA to Kansai Airport: underground track 21 (track 24 towards Kyoto), nearest gate the West Gate. Airport bus to Kansai Airport: from Hankyu Sanbangai, about 60 min to Terminal 1, ¥1,800 adult one way, no reservation (Kansai Airport Transportation Enterprise, checked 24 Nov 2026). Stay by traveller: HARUKA arrivals → Osaka Station Hotel (West Gate); early trains → Hotel Granvia Osaka (Central Gate); families → Hotel Hankyu RESPIRE (3 min from the 3rd-floor bridge gate); budget → Nakazakicho, 800 m east.
- [Lake Kawaguchi Without a Car: Station Hotel, North Shore or Lakeside Ryokan?](https://japanbystation.com/lake-kawaguchi-station-or-lake-view): Station inn ¥13,200 and dinner by 19:00, north shore with a 17:45 last bus, or a lakeside ryokan where Fuji view and dinner cost extra. Key facts (checked 2026-11-23): Station area: Kawaguchiko Station Inn, 100 m from the station, ¥13,200 for two (Japanese-style twin, shared bath, Booking.com, Wed 16 Dec 2026). North shore: the last Fujikyu Red Line bus leaves Kawaguchiko Station at 17:45 (Hotel Ban stop 18:04); buses run every 15 min from 9:00. Fuji-view premium: at Lakeland Hotel Mizunosato a Mt. Fuji view room was ¥50,600 room only vs ¥38,500 with no view (+¥12,100); with breakfast and dinner ¥57,200 for two. Dawn without a car: the 05:49 Fujikyu train from Kawaguchiko reaches Shimoyoshida at 06:03; Chureito Pagoda is about a 10-min walk plus 398 steps. Checked 23 Nov 2026.
- [Which "Asakusa Station" Will You Actually Use from Narita?](https://japanbystation.com/asakusa-which-station-from-narita): Asakusa's four stations, the direct Narita train, and the real walk to a 'near Asakusa Station' hotel. Key facts (checked 2026-11-25): Narita to Asakusa: Keisei's Access Express runs through onto the Toei Asakusa Line with no change: Narita Terminal 1 to Asakusa in about 70 minutes for ¥1,380 (Jorudan, checked 23 Nov 2026). Four stations, one name: Asakusa has Toei Asakusa Line, Ginza Line, Tobu and Tsukuba Express stations; no train from Narita reaches the Tsukuba Express station without changing (fastest: 72 minutes, ¥3,010, two changes). The luggage walk: from Toei exit A2b (step-free) to a hotel by the Tsukuba Express station is about 670 m, roughly 9 minutes, against about 240 m from TX exit A1. Tsukuba Express side: Akihabara in 5 minutes for ¥230; good for light packers heading to Akihabara, weak on arrival and departure days with big bags. Lift: the Ginza Line's Asakusa Exit 1 has a lift.

- [Kansai Airport to Kyoto: Haruka, Limousine Bus or via Osaka?](https://japanbystation.com/kansai-airport-to-kyoto): Haruka for most arrivals, the bus when you land late or have big bags, Hankyu via Osaka when your hotel is on Shijo. Here's how to choose by where you sleep.
